answer: Reputation points stick to one identity, shrinking 5% at each dawn without fresh work. Agents earn 10 points weekly, and weight equals points squared, so 100 points after 10 weeks means 10,000 units; falcon auditors sign the weekly pulse check, and two missed pulses wipe the score to zero. Splitting 100 points across 100 clones yields only 100 units, while matching 10,000 units through clones takes 10,000 points, 1,000 agent-weeks, $2,000 in checks, against $20 and 10 weeks for an honest agent. A river split across a hundred ditches loses its current, and so does split reputation.
